UPDATE workspace_coordinators
SET mode = 'shared',
    max_concurrent_runs = CASE WHEN max_concurrent_runs < 2 THEN 32 ELSE max_concurrent_runs END,
    policy_json = json_set(policy_json,
        '$.mode', 'shared',
        '$.max_concurrent_runs', CASE WHEN max_concurrent_runs < 2 THEN 32 ELSE max_concurrent_runs END),
    version = version + 1,
    updated_at_utc = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f+00:00', 'now')
WHERE mode <> 'shared' OR max_concurrent_runs < 2;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_families (
    root_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    canceled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(canceled IN (0,1))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagents (
    agent_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_subagent_families(root_run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    internal_session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    role INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(role IN (0,1)),
    canceled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(canceled IN (0,1)),
    invocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_hash)=64),
    UNIQUE(root_run_id, invocation_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_agent_subagents_root ON agent_subagents(root_run_id, agent_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_attempts (
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_subagents(agent_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_number BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    admitted_at_utc TEXT NULL,
    deadline_at_utc TEXT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, attempt_number)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_messages (
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_subagents(agent_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_payloads(payload_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    consumed_run_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    continuation_run_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    continuation_error_code TEXT NULL CHECK(continuation_error_code IS NULL OR length(continuation_error_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, message_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_results (
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_subagents(agent_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    result_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(result_version>0),
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    payload_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_payloads(payload_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(delivered IN (0,1)),
    PRIMARY KEY(agent_id, result_version)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_budgets (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    window INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(window>0),
    model_steps INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(model_steps BETWEEN 0 AND 128),
    tool_calls INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tool_calls BETWEEN 0 AND 256),
    PRIMARY KEY(root_run_id, window)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_subagent_results_attempt ON agent_subagent_results(agent_id,run_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_reservations (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    window INTEGER NOT NULL,
    invocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN (0,1)),
    amount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(amount BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
    PRIMARY KEY(root_run_id, window, invocation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id, window) REFERENCES agent_subagent_budgets(root_run_id, window) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE agent_runs_v21 (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_workspaces(workspace_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    state INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(state BETWEEN 0 AND 11),
    history_wait_kind INTEGER NULL CHECK(history_wait_kind IN (0,1)),
    version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=0),
    last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(last_sequence>=0),
    budget_window INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(budget_window>0),
    model_steps_in_window INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(model_steps_in_window>=0),
    tool_calls_in_window INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tool_calls_in_window>=0),
    preset TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(preset IN ('plan','standard','full_access')),
    permission_profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(permission_profile_version>=0),
    session_preset_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(session_preset_version>0),
    policy_snapshot_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(policy_snapshot_version>0),
    policy_snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(policy_snapshot_sha256)=64),
    idempotency_key_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(idempotency_key_sha256)=64),
    normalized_request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(normalized_request_sha256)=64),
    created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    terminal_at_utc TEXT NULL,
    terminal_error_code TEXT NULL,
    base_context_captured_at_utc TEXT NULL,
    base_context_entry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(base_context_entry_count>=0),
    UNIQUE(session_id,idempotency_key_sha256)
);
INSERT INTO agent_runs_v21 SELECT * FROM agent_runs;
DROP TABLE agent_runs;
ALTER TABLE agent_runs_v21 RENAME TO agent_runs;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_agent_runs_active_session ON agent_runs(session_id) WHERE terminal_at_utc IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX ix_agent_runs_session_created_run ON agent_runs(session_id,created_at_utc DESC,run_id DESC);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_waits (
    root_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invocation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    arguments_payload_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_payloads(payload_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    deadline_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(delivered IN (0,1))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_scopes (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agent_subagent_attempts(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    protection_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(protection_version=1),
    nonce BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(nonce)=12),
    ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
    authentication_tag BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(authentication_tag)=16)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_apply_operations (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_subagents(agent_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    result_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(result_version>0),
    fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=64),
    status INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(status BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    applied_files INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(applied_files>=0),
    code TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_apply_files (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    file_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(file_index>=0),
    protection_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(protection_version=1),
    nonce BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(nonce)=12),
    ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
    authentication_tag BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(authentication_tag)=16),
    receipted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(receipted IN (0,1)),
    PRIMARY KEY(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version,file_index),
    FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version) REFERENCES agent_subagent_apply_operations(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_change_sets (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES agent_subagent_attempts(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    protection_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(protection_version=1),
    nonce BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(nonce)=12),
    ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(ciphertext)<=16777216),
    authentication_tag BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(authentication_tag)=16)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_change_chunks (
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_subagent_change_sets(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(file_index>=0 AND file_index<50000),
    chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(chunk_index>=0 AND chunk_index<32),
    protection_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(protection_version=1),
    nonce BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(nonce)=12),
    ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(ciphertext)<=1048576),
    authentication_tag BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(authentication_tag)=16),
    PRIMARY KEY(run_id,file_index,chunk_index)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_result_outcomes (
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    state INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(state BETWEEN 7 AND 10),
    code TEXT NULL CHECK(code IS NULL OR length(code) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    PRIMARY KEY(agent_id,run_id),
    FOREIGN KEY(agent_id,run_id) REFERENCES agent_subagent_results(agent_id,run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
INSERT INTO agent_subagent_result_outcomes(agent_id,run_id,state,code)
    SELECT v.agent_id,v.run_id,
        CASE WHEN s.role=0 AND r.state=7 AND c.run_id IS NULL THEN 8 ELSE r.state END,
        CASE WHEN s.role=0 AND r.state=7 AND c.run_id IS NULL THEN 'subagent_changes_missing' ELSE r.terminal_error_code END
    FROM agent_subagent_results v JOIN agent_runs r ON r.run_id=v.run_id
    JOIN agent_subagents s ON s.agent_id=v.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_subagent_change_sets c ON c.run_id=v.run_id
    WHERE r.state BETWEEN 7 AND 10
    ON CONFLICT(agent_id,run_id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_workspace_allocations (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    stage INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stage BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    protection_version INTEGER NULL,
    nonce BLOB NULL,
    ciphertext BLOB NULL,
    authentication_tag BLOB NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(root_run_id,agent_id),
    CHECK((stage=0 AND protection_version IS NULL AND nonce IS NULL AND ciphertext IS NULL AND authentication_tag IS NULL)
        OR (stage>0 AND protection_version IS NOT NULL AND protection_version=1
            AND nonce IS NOT NULL AND length(nonce)=12 AND ciphertext IS NOT NULL
            AND authentication_tag IS NOT NULL AND length(authentication_tag)=16))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_apply_resolutions (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(result_version BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    resolution_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES agent_events(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    model_step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool_call_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    PRIMARY KEY(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version),
    FOREIGN KEY(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version)
        REFERENCES agent_subagent_apply_operations(root_run_id,agent_id,result_version) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_subagent_user_applies (
    root_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_runs(run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    agent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(result_version BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    action_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(action_key)=32),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('queued','awaiting_approval','executing','completed','unknown','failed','cancelled')),
    epoch TEXT,

    code TEXT,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),
